result.summary: Fixes an assertion in `test/functional/p2p_blocksonly.py` to check for a transaction's wtxid rather than its txid when verifying that RPC-submitted transactions are not announced to block-relay-only peers. It also adds an outbound full-relay peer connection to positively assert receipt of the wtxid announcement.
result.problem: The test peer negotiates `wtxidrelay` and the test transaction contains a witness, meaning announcements use the wtxid instead of the txid. Because the test previously asserted the absence of the txid, the check passed vacuously even if the node improperly announced the transaction.
evidence: PR description: "The peer is a P2PTxInvStore, which negotiates wtxidrelay, so an announcement would carry the wtxid. The MiniWallet transaction has a witness, so its txid and wtxid differ, and the check passes whether or not the node announces it."
Commit message: "With the connection opened as outbound-full-relay rather than block-relay-only, the old assertion still passes and the new one fails."
result.changed_since_previous: Added an outbound-full-relay peer to the functional test to positively assert that the wtxid is announced, ensuring the absence check on the block-relay connection cannot pass vacuously.
result.card: Fixes an assertion in functional test p2p_blocksonly.py by checking for the transaction wtxid instead of txid. Because the test peer negotiates wtxidrelay and the transaction has a witness, any announcement uses the wtxid, causing the previous txid absence check to pass vacuously even if the transaction was announced. The PR also adds an outbound-full-relay peer to positively assert that the wtxid was broadcast.

risk.why: Modifies only functional test assertions and adds a test peer connection.
